title.narrative: Civil Society Support Programme II

description.narrative: The purpose of the project, and therefore of this programme estimate, is to strengthen the umbrella organisation, thematic networks and Civil Society¿s capacities so that it can engage effectively and constructively with the Government of Samoa, as well as complement the main EU budget Support Programme by further improving water quality, and address specific gender related issues such as Stereotyping and Inequality.
